description: Append a version-linked journal note; does not modify existing notes. Requires FXMacroData account access; owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

body.description: Journal note text, 1-6000 characters; no credentials.

book_id.description: 32 lowercase hex paper-account ID from an owned account result.

event_id.description: Optional paper event ID from this version; omit for an unlinked note.

kind.description: Journal note category: hypothesis, observation, decision or review.

version_id.description: Exact version_id belonging to this paper account, copied from its read result.

name: research_paper_append_journal
title: Append Paper Journal
